entries.description: Classical Revival mixed-use commercial and residential building

historic_survey.cr_status_note: Assigned on architectural criteria alone; the survey records it as provisional pending further research.
historic_survey.rating_note: The survey reports ratings from the 1976 citywide architectural survey on a 0-5 scale, 5 being individual significance of the highest degree. It gives no scale for the Carey & Company or UMB survey ratings, so those are recorded here but not shown on the page.

historical_record.description: One of the two most ambitious masonry mixed-use buildings of the 1920s boom on Third Street, with 5172–74: three storeys clad in yellow brick, with extruded sheet-metal-clad bay windows, a bracketed cornice, two storefronts at street level and two levels of apartments above. Both stand at the southern edge of the commercial district, where lots large enough for such footprints were still to be had.
